Each pair: light mode (left) and dark mode (right)
How are you feeling right now?
52 px tall · radius 16 · crisis red only for Call
Hi, I'm Chipu. How are you feeling?
Bubbles: radius 22, 6 px corner on the sender side
• Screen: 360 × 800 (Android compact) · 16 px side padding · 12 px between cards
• Cards: white, 1 px border, radius 16, no shadow · Bottom sheets: radius 24 on top corners
• Inputs: radius 24 · chat message box: pill (radius 28) with a 44 px round send button
• Red is only for crisis support and Call buttons, so it always means "urgent help"
• Primary green #2F7A5D on white = 5.2:1 contrast (passes WCAG AA)
